title.purpose: Page/section identity — the Quant wordmark, panel headers. Never larger than 1.125rem; there is no display tier.

body.purpose: Nav items, prose, form controls, general UI text. Fixed rem scale, not fluid clamp().

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: nav group headers, the MMMXCIX eyebrow, tracked annotations.

data.purpose: Any number a user reads live or historically — KPI values, prices, countdowns, kbd hints. Always tabular-nums.

shadows.name: glass-ambient-light
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow under every .lg-glass panel in light mode.

shadows.name: glass-ambient-dark
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow under every .lg-glass panel in dark mode.

shadows.name: hover-lift-bloom
shadows.purpose: Added shadow when an .hover-lift card is hovered, alongside a 3px upward translate.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Default easing for page entry, staggered card reveals, and hover-lift transforms.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Color/background/border/transform transitions on buttons, chips, inputs.

motion.name: duration-page-entry
motion.purpose: view-in — the whole page's entry animation, kept task-length.

motion.name: duration-chart-reveal
motion.purpose: draw-in / wipe-in — self-drawing sparkline and chart-line reveals.

motion.name: duration-tick-flash
motion.purpose: flash-up / flash-down — brief tint when a live value changes.

motion.name: duration-ambient-drift
motion.purpose: Background glow drift — deliberately slow so it's felt, not seen.

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation link in its active state — accent-tinted fill plus a left accent bar.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(24,24,26,0.10); color: #18181a; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item--active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -8px; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #18181a; } .ds-nav-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Nav Item (idle)
components.description: Sidebar navigation link at rest, brightening to full ink on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: rgba(24,24,26,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(24,24,26,0.40); color: #18181a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: rgba(24,24,26,0.25); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(24,24,26,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button, surface background with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; color: #585860; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #0c0c0f; border-color: rgba(228,228,231,0.8); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Filter Chip (active/idle)
components.description: Pill-shaped toggle used for timeframe and filter selection.
components.html: 1D1W
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip--active { border-color: rgba(24,24,26,0.5); color: #18181a; background: rgba(24,24,26,0.10); } .ds-chip--idle { border-color: #e4e4e7; color: #585860; background: rgba(12,12,15,0.05); } .ds-chip--idle:hover { color: #0c0c0f; background: rgba(12,12,15,0.09); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field used across screener and backtest forms.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #0c0c0f; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(88,88,96,0.6); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(24,24,26,0.5); }

components.name: KPI / Glass Card
components.description: Frosted glass metric card used across Dashboard, Portfolio and Monitor.
components.css: .ds-kpi-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; padding: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.74); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(140%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(12,12,15,0.05), 0 14px 34px -14px rgba(12,12,15,0.16); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), box-shadow 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-kpi-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(12,12,15,0.16) 50%, transparent 100%); } .ds-kpi-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(24,24,26,0.35); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(12,12,15,0.06), 0 24px 48px -20px rgba(12,12,15,0.28); } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #585860; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; color: #0c0c0f; }

narrative.overview:
Every quant tool has the same job: pull signal out of noise. This system makes that job literal. Underneath the interface sits a WebGL dither field and a fine grain layer — actual visual noise, drifting so slowly (a 96–120 second cycle) it registers as atmosphere, not motion. Over it sits frosted glass: panels that blur and saturate whatever noise sits behind them into a soft, present depth. Above all of that, the interface itself renders in exactly two non-negotiable colors — near-black ink on near-white paper by day, near-white ink on near-black paper by night — with a single rule standing guard: nothing on this screen is allowed to carry color except the market data itself. The accent isn't a brand hue borrowed from a style guide; the accent is the ink. When something turns green or red, that's not decoration, that's the answer to the only question a trader actually asked.

This is a product register system: the user is in a task, and the interface's job is to disappear into that task with the fluency of Linear or a Bloomberg terminal — not to perform a brand identity at them. It explicitly rejects the loud, gamified, glow-everywhere register of consumer trading apps: no rainbow category chips, no level-up celebration animation, no mascot. Restraint is the whole point; a monochrome interface reads as more serious, not less, because the only thing left to notice is the data.
keyCharacteristics: Two-color monochrome ramp (paper/ink) per theme; color reserved entirely for up/down/warn market signals.
Frosted glass over a slow WebGL dither + grain field — depth you feel, not decoration you notice.
Inter for every UI surface; JetBrains Mono exclusively for live or historical numbers.
Motion is short and task-length (page entry ≤0.3s), never a performance the user has to sit through.
Every interactive state (hover/focus-visible/active/disabled) is explicit and consistent across all controls.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-Ink Rule
rules.body: There is no separate brand accent color. In light mode the accent is Graphite Ink; in dark mode it is near-white. The interface's only "color" is its own ink, at full opacity, on interactive elements — never a hue borrowed from a marketing palette.

rules.name: The One-Hue-Per-Fact Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and ochre are reserved exclusively for real market facts. They never appear as decoration, category-coding, or brand flourish.

rules.name: The Numerals-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any value that is a number a user reads live or historically renders in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums. Everything else stays in Inter.

rules.name: The Felt-Not-Seen Rule
rules.body: The ambient gradient glows and the dither/grain field must never be identifiable as an object on the page — they drift on 96–120 second cycles specifically so a user never catches them moving.

dos: Do keep color to exactly four roles: the ink/paper ramp, and up/down/warn signal colors.
Do render every live or historical number in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do keep page-entry motion at or under ~0.3s and stagger children in ~30ms steps.
Do collapse every animation, transform, and the grain-layer opacity under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do give every interactive control all of default / hover / focus-visible / active / disabled.
Do use .lg-frost for fixed chrome and the lighter .lg-glass for in-content cards.
donts: Don't introduce a decorative brand accent color.
Don't let the ambient glow, dither field, or grain layer become identifiable as a moving object.
Don't paint an opaque background on <body>.
Don't reach for a display/hero font size or a fluid clamp() heading.
Don't add gamified flourish — level-up glows, confetti, mascots, rainbow category coding.
